note: Interest rate tags sit in this column's cells, and n1 equals the tagged interest_rate on nearly every row. In the 'incl. PIK' shapes n1 is the all-in rate and n2 matches the tagged pik_rate. The '#% PIK' shape has only one row; its n1 matches both the interest_rate and pik_rate tags, so the PIK role is a judgment call.
